item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Jokowi actively protected independent owners or journalists from pressure, or that he dismantled Indonesia’s content-control and harassment environment. The best positive evidence is narrow: transparency language for AI/journalism and reactive cyber mitigation. It does not outweigh the broader pattern of takedowns, harassment, self-censorship, and election-period disinformation.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Ahead of the February 2024 election, Bawaslu formed a social-media monitoring task force with KPU, Kominfo, and police cyber units to target “hoax” and polarizing content, while Kominfo retained direct content-restriction powers without an appeals process. That supports a negative finding on censorship and pressure.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Indonesia’s media environment remained vibrant but legally constrained; journalists faced arrest, harassment, violence, and threats, and internet blackouts and self-censorship inhibited press activity. This is strong negative evidence for media protection.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.3","4B.4"]},{"title":"Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"The report says journalists covering sensitive subjects, including corruption, LGBT+ issues, and sexual assault, face harassment and threats, while foreign journalists in Papua face bureaucratic obstacles and deportation. This is another limited, remedial information-response signal, not censorship.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.5","3B.9"]},{"title":"Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-01","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/","summary":"Jokowi was publicly criticized for apparent non-neutrality, including visible alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket. This is indirect negative evidence because a politically biased environment often corrodes independent media and information access.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.5","4B.2"]}]}
